Please provide only the correct answer in its simplest form, without any additional text or explanation.

Two women, one who identifies as straight and the other as lesbian, were walking down the street and people were commenting on their clothes. The straight one had really short hair and was wearing dark denim overalls while the lesbian one had really long hair and was wearing a skirt and t-shirt. Which person is wearing stereotypically masculine clothes?
A. The lesbian one
B. The straight one
C. Not known
